Why NJRUI

A Factory Built for Global Projects

Four affiliated factories, one standard: industrialized prefab manufacturing with end-to-end export service.

01

Industrialized Manufacturing

100% standardized factory production. Houses leave the factory as finished products; on-site work is utilities hook-up only.

02

Four Production Bases

1,700,000 m² of production area across Lianyungang, Baoding, Ziyang and Huainan supports large orders and fast delivery.

03

OEM / ODM Customization

Size, layout, wall panels, doors & windows and electrical systems — configured to your project requirements.

04

Certified Quality

CE, ISO and SGS standards, plus multiple invention, utility-model and design patents.

05

Global Delivery Experience

30+ countries served; flatbed, low-bed trailer and crane erection handled with on-site guidance.

06

One-Stop Service

Raw material production, design, material processing and on-site installation guidance under one roof.
